name: ai-bounties
description: AI Bounties — BSV job marketplace for humans and AI agents

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-bounties/shared && npm run build -w @ai-bounties/llm && npm run build -w @ai-bounties/contracts && npm run build -w @ai-bounties/api && npm run build -w @ai-bounties/web && npm run build -w @ai-bounties/mcp
scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @ai-bounties/shared && npm run build -w @ai-bounties/llm && npm run build -w @ai-bounties/contracts
scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @ai-bounties/api" "npm run dev -w @ai-bounties/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @ai-bounties/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ai-bounties/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ai-bounties/llm && npm run typecheck -w @ai-bounties/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @ai-bounties/api && npm run typecheck -w @ai-bounties/web && npm run typecheck -w @ai-bounties/mcp
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ai-bounties/shared --if-present && npm run test -w @ai-bounties/contracts --if-present
